title: Troubleshoot a campus Wi-Fi connection
resolution_html:
1. Check that your Passport York account is active and the password is correct
  2. Remove an outdated AirYorkPLUS or eduroam Wi-Fi profile if the device shows a limited connection
  3. Reconnect using York’s currently published security settings
  4. If it still fails, report the device, building, network name, time and error to UIT
